extracted.name: Simple Waldorf Salad
extracted.description: Who doesn’t love a crunchy Waldorf salad? This recipe combines apples, celery, raisins, and walnuts in a creamy mayo and vinegar dressing.
instruction_lines: Whisk mayonnaise and vinegar together in a mixing bowl.
Add apples, celery, raisins, and walnuts. Season with salt and pepper; mix well.
Chill salad before serving, at least 30 minutes.
